messages:
Marcos: 🚨 Heads up — we've got a spike in hallucination reports from customers after the 2026-03-12 model deploy (model v3.2.0). Error rate on QA evals jumped and live traces show unusual repeated inventing of facts. Paging now.

Oncall Bot: @channel incident created: INC-2026-0312-02 — high-sev quality regression. Pager: Sam (oncall).

Sam: I'm on it. pulling logs and sample traces now. Can someone drop the deploy link and rollout percentage?

Anya: Rollout was 100% across hosted, started at 03:04 UTC. Canary looked ok for small corpus but CI evals showed a subtle BLEU-style shift we missed.

Sam: repro with customer prompt set happening in prod. Rate of hallucination ~ 8% vs baseline 0.7%. That's customer visible.

Lena: tagging Support to surface top affected customers and whether they've raised tickets. @Support Bot please list recent cases.

Support Bot: Found 14 support threads in last 30m with severity high/med referring to invented facts. Top impacted customers: AcmeCorp, BrightHealth (EU), QuickForms.

Matt: we need a mitigation plan. Options: 1) immediate rollback to v3.1.7, 2) pin affected customers to v3.1.7 only, 3) tweak safety/decoder config. Rollback seems fastest.

Anya: I agree — rollback global rollout, then pin while we triage root cause. Rolling forward with fixes risks more customer impact.

Sam: executing rollback now. Command run:```bash
# rollback to v3.1.7
redwoodctl deploy set-default --model-id redwood-text-3 --version 3.1.7 --scope hosted
redwoodctl rollout wait --until stable
```

Ops Runbook Bot: Runbook step executed: rollback-inference-image. Time estimate to stable: ~6-10 min.

Marcos: Drafting status page update. Copy suggestion: "We are investigating a quality regression affecting text generation for model redwood-text-3 after a recent deploy. We have initiated a rollback to the prior model version and are monitoring stability. Some customers may experience degraded responses — we will follow up with impacted customers directly." Thoughts?

Lena: tweak to call out customer action: add a note to reach out to support if they see critical production impact. Also add ETA for next update (30m).

Anya: final status page draft: "Status: Partial degradation (mitigated) — We detected a quality regression in model redwood-text-3 and have rolled back to version 3.1.7. Engineers are monitoring; next update in 30 minutes. Impact: some generated responses may contain inaccurate or fabricated content. If you rely on factual accuracy, consider temporarily pinning to v3.1.7 or pausing generation."

Marcos: posting to status page now.

Ops Runbook Bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0312-02

Sam: rollback showing success on 6/8 pools, errors on two legacy GPU clusters (timeouts). Re-running rollout for those clusters.

Matt: prepping customer notification for top-affected. Draft: "We detected a regression in model redwood-text-3 that can produce incorrect/fabricated content. We rolled back to the previous model (v3.1.7) and are monitoring. If you depend on factual outputs, we recommend pinning to v3.1.7 now. We're available to help pin or review logs. Apologies for the disruption."

Lena: add link to one-click pin in Console and a snippet customers can run via API.

Marcos: customer pin snippet:```http
POST /v1/deployments/pin
Authorization: Bearer <key>
{
  "customer_id": "<id>",
  "model": "redwood-text-3",
  "version": "3.1.7"
}
```

Support Bot: Templates queued to send to top affected customers. Will use higher-touch channel for BrightHealth (compliance/regional).

Sam: rollout fully successful at 1768501502, all pools stable. Starting a lightweight A/B diag comparing v3.2.0 vs v3.1.7 on test harness to pinpoint logits shift.

Anya: recording incident tag: cause unknown — likely training/data shuffle or decoding change. Team owning model onboarding (ML infra) to investigate gradients/merge history.

Marcos: action items: 1) ML infra to diff model checkpoints and tokenization config (owner: Anya), 2) Eng runtime to add extra canary checks for factuality evals (owner: Matt), 3) Support to notify customers & offer pin assistance (owner: Lena). Add timelines: initial RCA in 24h.

Matt: noting follow-up: add automatic rollback threshold if hallucination rate > 2% vs baseline during rollout. I'll file the RFC tomorrow.

Lena: handing off to day shift: @Anya take lead once Sam signs off? Sam, please post final status and handoff when you go offline.

Sam: Signing off handoff — system stable, status page updated, top customers notified (tickets created). Leaving debugging to Anya. Last check: hallucination rate back to baseline.

Marcos: thanks all. Final note for post-incident comms: include sample prompts and affected batch IDs in the RCA, and include customer-specific timelines for follow-ups.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0312-02 closed (mitigated) at 1768501820. Follow-up tasks created: TASK-1124 (RCA), TASK-1125 (canary-factuality), TASK-1126 (pin-tooling).

Support Bot: Closing notes — outreach done to all 14 customers, three requested assisted pinning (tickets 8941, 8942, 8943).

Marcos: filing comms draft to #marketing and @CS for any customer-facing blog or deeper writeup. Good job team :thumbsup:"
